mapping.sheet: Default board, three arms and two feet use measured 1.60 mm sheet; custom range 1.6–2.4 mm. Three spacers intentionally have different heights.
mapping.socket: Two 4.50-mm-wide, sheet-thick, sheet-long tongues on the board engage foot sockets. Proposed total clearance 0.10–0.30 mm is added to each slot axis, default 4.65 × 1.75 mm. No switch socket applies.
mapping.carrier: Original 3-row carrier, 2.4-mm rails and 36 accessible bed-contact runners. Proposed runner thickness 0.4–0.6 mm is thicker than measured 0.21–0.22 mm.
mapping.redesign: Original nine-part Routh-theorem assembly: upright triangular board, three slotted cevian arms, three stepped-height spacer rings and two tongue/socket feet. Three external M3 pivots retain layered rigid arms. Ratio rebuilds target points and arm lengths, not decorative textures.
mapping.clearance: Proposed M3 bores 3.2–3.5 mm, arm-plane gaps 0.8–1.2 mm. Hand-guided ±8-degree neighborhood checked; no physical stops or full-turn clearance claim. Feet require adhesive.
mapping.personalization: Image heightfield or exact supported imported STL Boolean-subtracted from board apron centered at (0,10) mm, keep-in radius 6.5 mm, ≥1mm continuous backing. No convex-hull replacement.
mapping.limitations: Reference is not watertight; used only to measure construction, not repaired or bundled. New CSG solids independently verified. Physical printing, strength, stability and friction untested.
